```lean
induction' n with n IHn
· intro m
  have : 0 ≤ x ^ m := pow_nonneg hx m
  rw [Finset.Ico_zero, sum_empty, zero_div]
  exact this
· intro m
  have h1 : 0 < 1 - x := sub_pos (le_of_lt h'x) (le_of_lt hx)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ x ^ m := pow_nonneg hx m
  have h3 : 0 ≤ x ^ (m + 1) := pow_nonneg hx (m + 1)
  rw [Finset.Ico_succ, sum_insert, add_right_inj, pow_add]
  calc
    x ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (m + 1) n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m + x ^ (m + 1) / (1 - x) by
      refine le_add_of_le_left _ h2
      exact IHn (m + 1) (le_refl _) (le_trans (le_of_lt h'x) (lt_of_lt_of_le h'x (le_of_lt hx)))
    x ^ m + x ^ (m + 1) / (1 - x) = x ^ m * (1 + x / (1 - x)) :=
      by simp only [add_mul, mul_div, one_add, div_add_div']
    x ^ m * (1 + x / (1 - x)) = x ^ m * (1 - x + x) / (1 - x) :=
      by simp only [add_div, add_sub, mul_add, one_sub, add_assoc]
    x ^ m * (1 - x + x) / (1 - x) = x ^ m * 1 / (1 - x) :=
      by simp only [add_self_eq_twice, add_right_inj, mul_one]
    x ^ m / (1 - x) = x ^ m / (1 - x)
  exact this
```
